metadata.name: Seville parkings (OED occupancy 1113)
metadata.note: Synthetic car-park portfolio for the OED occupancy-code path. Each asset carries occupancy_code=1113 (OED 'Commercial, Parking'), which maps to Hazus COM10 when the OED-Hazus flag is enabled on the API, and to RealEstate Buildings/Commercial otherwise. Values and physical attributes are illustrative.
metadata.storeys_codes: positive = known storey count; -1/-2/-3 = unknown low/mid/high rise
metadata.value_meaning: value is the STRUCTURE (deck/building) replacement value used as the platform TIV. contents_value is garage building equipment (MEP, ticketing, ventilation), not vehicles. Vehicle exposure is derived in the notebook from parking_spaces x occupancy x avg_vehicle_value.
metadata.occupancy_meaning: occupancy = share of spaces occupied at the modelled flood time (utilization)

field_groups.required_for_physical_risk: id, name, country, latitude, and longitude. Coordinates drive the hazard lookup; id links API results back to assets.
field_groups.exposure_and_loss_inputs: value, contents_value, parking_spaces, and occupancy. These scale structure, overview, vehicle, and cooling-cost calculations in the notebook.
field_groups.routing_and_vulnerability_inputs: occupancy_code, asset_class, type, location, number_of_storeys, basement, and first_floor_height. These describe the intended parking-asset route and flood-vulnerability assumptions.
field_groups.descriptive_fields: display_type, description, and zone. These help users identify and contextualize assets in tables and charts.
